title.narrative: Support to Development of Cultural Tourism

description.narrative: Overall Objective: The overall objective of the project Support to Development of Cultural Tourism is to contribute to national economic growth through developing the Palestinian tourism sector by revitalized cultural infrastructure and increased engagement of Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs).Specific Objective: Specific objectives of this project are:1. To contribute towards conserving and protecting cultural infrastructure; 2. To improve the potential for cultural, eco-tourism and creative industries for an inclusive economic growth;3. To contribute towards raising awareness of the local communities about the importance of cultural heritage; 4. To provide job opportunities mainly for young professionals and women (craftsmanship, tourism and cultural management), and improved engagement with the local private sector;5. To increase the number of tourists and visitors to the State of Palestine in addition to adding new touristic routes with the new concept of connecting the landscape with the environmental, archaeological sites and historical buildings;6. To increase the income for local communities by providing access to tourists and, hence, new economic opportunities.
